text: Alice is married under section 7703 for the year 2017. Alice files a joint return with her spouse for 2017. Alice's and her spouse's taxable income for the year 2017 is $17330.
question: Alice and her spouse have to pay $2600 in taxes for the year 2017 under section 1(a)(i).
reference_prolog:
/* ---------- Statutory rules (excerpts) ---------- */

/* Tax computation under section 1(a) - married individuals filing joint returns and surviving spouses */
tax_section_1a(TI, Tax) :-
    ( TI =< 36900 ->
        Tax is 0.15 * TI
    ; TI =< 89150 ->
        Tax is 5535 + 0.28 * (TI - 36900)
    ; TI =< 140000 ->
        Tax is 20165 + 0.31 * (TI - 89150)
    ; TI =< 250000 ->
        Tax is 35928.50 + 0.36 * (TI - 140000)
    ;
        Tax is 75528.50 + 0.396 * (TI - 250000)
    ).

/* ---------- Facts for the case ---------- */

taxable_income(alice, 17330).
married_under_7703(alice).
files_joint_return(alice).

/* ---------- Derivation of Alice and spouse's tax liability ---------- */

alice_and_spouse_tax(Tax) :-
    taxable_income(alice, TI),
    married_under_7703(alice),
    files_joint_return(alice),
    tax_section_1a(TI, Tax).

/* ---------- Verification of the claim ---------- */

:- (  alice_and_spouse_tax(Tax),
      round(Tax, Rounded),
      Rounded =:= 2600
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.

text: Alice is a surviving spouse for the year 2017. Alice's taxable income for the year 2017 is $95129.
question: Alice has to pay $22018 in taxes for the year 2017 under section 1(a)(ii).
reference_prolog:
/* ---------- Case facts ---------- */

taxable_income(alice, 2017, 95129).
surviving_spouse(alice, 2017).

/* ---------- Statutory eligibility: section 1(a) ---------- */

section1a_taxpayer(Person, Year) :-
    surviving_spouse(Person, Year).

/* ---------- Statutory tax computations: section 1(a) ---------- */

tax_under_section1a_i(TaxableIncome, Tax) :-
    TaxableIncome =< 36900,
    Tax is 0.15 * TaxableIncome.

tax_under_section1a_ii(TaxableIncome, Tax) :-
    TaxableIncome > 36900,
    TaxableIncome =< 89150,
    Tax is 5535 + 0.28 * (TaxableIncome - 36900).

tax_under_section1a_iii(TaxableIncome, Tax) :-
    TaxableIncome > 89150,
    TaxableIncome =< 140000,
    Tax is 20165 + 0.31 * (TaxableIncome - 89150).

tax_under_section1a_iv(TaxableIncome, Tax) :-
    TaxableIncome > 140000,
    TaxableIncome =< 250000,
    Tax is 35928.50 + 0.36 * (TaxableIncome - 140000).

tax_under_section1a_v(TaxableIncome, Tax) :-
    TaxableIncome > 250000,
    Tax is 75528.50 + 0.396 * (TaxableIncome - 250000).

/* ---------- Tax imposed under specific section 1(a) clauses ---------- */

tax_imposed(Person, Year, section1_a_i, Tax) :-
    section1a_taxpayer(Person, Year),
    taxable_income(Person, Year, TaxableIncome),
    tax_under_section1a_i(TaxableIncome, Tax).

tax_imposed(Person, Year, section1_a_ii, Tax) :-
    section1a_taxpayer(Person, Year),
    taxable_income(Person, Year, TaxableIncome),
    tax_under_section1a_ii(TaxableIncome, Tax).

tax_imposed(Person, Year, section1_a_iii, Tax) :-
    section1a_taxpayer(Person, Year),
    taxable_income(Person, Year, TaxableIncome),
    tax_under_section1a_iii(TaxableIncome, Tax).

tax_imposed(Person, Year, section1_a_iv, Tax) :-
    section1a_taxpayer(Person, Year),
    taxable_income(Person, Year, TaxableIncome),
    tax_under_section1a_iv(TaxableIncome, Tax).

tax_imposed(Person, Year, section1_a_v, Tax) :-
    section1a_taxpayer(Person, Year),
    taxable_income(Person, Year, TaxableIncome),
    tax_under_section1a_v(TaxableIncome, Tax).

/* ---------- Verification of the claim ----------
   Claim: Alice has to pay $22018 in taxes for 2017 under section 1(a)(ii).
*/

:- ( tax_imposed(alice, 2017, section1_a_ii, Tax),
     Tax =:= 22018
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.

text: Alice's taxable income for the year 2017 is $22895. Alice is not married, is not a surviving spouse, and is not a head of household in 2017.
question: Alice has to pay $3538 in taxes for the year 2017 under section 1(c)(iii).
reference_prolog:
/* ---------- Statutory rules (excerpts) ---------- */

/* Tax computation under section 1(c) - unmarried individuals (other than surviving spouses and heads of household) */
tax_section_1c(TI, Tax) :-
    ( TI =< 22100 ->
        Tax is 0.15 * TI
    ; TI =< 53500 ->
        Tax is 3315 + 0.28 * (TI - 22100)
    ; TI =< 115000 ->
        Tax is 12107 + 0.31 * (TI - 53500)
    ; TI =< 250000 ->
        Tax is 31172 + 0.36 * (TI - 115000)
    ;
        Tax is 79772 + 0.396 * (TI - 250000)
    ).

/* ---------- Facts for the case ---------- */

taxable_income(alice, 22895).
not_married(alice).
not_surviving_spouse(alice).
not_head_of_household(alice).

/* ---------- Marital status for Alice (derived from facts) ---------- */

/* Under section 7703(a): marital status is determined as of the close of the taxable year. */
married_under_7703(_Person) :- fail.

/* ---------- Classification for Alice ---------- */

/* Section 1(c) applies when an individual is not married, not a surviving spouse, and not a head of household. */
unmarried_individual_other_than_surviving_spouse_or_head_of_household(Person) :-
    \+ married_under_7703(Person),
    not_surviving_spouse(Person),
    not_head_of_household(Person).

/* ---------- Derivation of Alice's tax liability ---------- */

alice_tax(Tax) :-
    taxable_income(alice, TI),
    unmarried_individual_other_than_surviving_spouse_or_head_of_household(alice),
    tax_section_1c(TI, Tax).

/* ---------- Verification of the claim ---------- */

claim_tax(3538).

:- (  alice_tax(Tax),
      claim_tax(ClaimTax),
      Tax =:= ClaimTax
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.

text: Alice and Bob got married on Feb 3rd, 1992. Alice died on July 9th, 2014. Alice was a nonresident alien since March 4th, 1990.
question: Section 2(a)(2)(B) applies to Bob in 2014.
reference_prolog:
/* ---------- Date utilities ---------- */
date_before(date(Y1,M1,D1), date(Y2,M2,D2)) :-
    ( Y1 < Y2
    ; Y1 =:= Y2, M1 < M2
    ; Y1 =:= Y2, M1 =:= M2, D1 < D2
    ).

date_on_or_before(D, D).
date_on_or_before(D1, D2) :-
    date_before(D1, D2).

date_on_or_after(D, D).
date_on_or_after(D1, D2) :-
    date_before(D2, D1).

year_start(Y, date(Y,1,1)).
year_end(Y, date(Y,12,31)).

interval_overlaps_year(Start, End, Year) :-
    year_start(Year, YearStart),
    year_end(Year, YearEnd),
    date_on_or_before(Start, YearEnd),
    ( End = ongoing
    ; date_on_or_after(End, YearStart)
    ).

/* ---------- Case facts ---------- */
person(alice).
person(bob).

married(alice, bob, date(1992,2,3)).
died(alice, date(2014,7,9)).
nonresident_alien_status(alice, date(1990,3,4), ongoing).

/* ---------- Relationship helpers ---------- */
spouse_of(X, Y) :- married(X, Y, _).
spouse_of(X, Y) :- married(Y, X, _).

died_in_year(Person, Year) :-
    died(Person, Date),
    year_start(Year, Start),
    year_end(Year, End),
    date_on_or_after(Date, Start),
    date_on_or_before(Date, End).

/* ---------- Section 2(a)(2)(B) ----------
   For surviving spouse status, the subsection does not apply if
   the deceased spouse was a nonresident alien at any time during the taxable year.
*/
section2_a_2_B_applies_to(Taxpayer, Year) :-
    spouse_of(Taxpayer, DeceasedSpouse),
    died_in_year(DeceasedSpouse, Year),
    \+ (
        nonresident_alien_status(DeceasedSpouse, Start, End),
        interval_overlaps_year(Start, End, Year)
    ).

:- ( section2_a_2_B_applies_to(bob, 2014) -> format('Result: Entailment~n') ; format('Result: Contradiction~n') ).
:- halt.
